title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
hints: Every path has a highest node where it 'turns'. If you knew, for every node, the best downward path that starts there, could you score each node as the turning point?
Post-order: gain(node) = node.val + max(0, gain(left), gain(right)). A negative branch is worth dropping entirely, which is what the clamp at 0 does.
The best path turning at a node is node.val + max(0, left gain) + max(0, right gain). Update a global best with that at every node, but return only the single-branch gain upward.
